Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The agent misinterpreted the task’s time constraint. Instead of verifying whether members held C‑suite roles at the time they joined Apple’s board, it checked only if they had ever held C‑suite positions “before joining.” This led to misclassification starting with Wanda Austin (and later Alex Gorsky, Ronald D. Sugar, Susan L. Wagner), who were not in C‑suite roles when they joined, resulting in the incorrect conclusion that all members held C‑suite roles upon joining.
